mentions.name: Web-based guitar RPG
mentions.description: A web-based RPG where players fight monsters, craft, and conjure magic by playing real notes on an actual guitar. Pitch detection runs in the browser via the Web Audio API, gamifying guitar practice to make it more fun.
mentions.problem: Guitar practice can feel dull; adding gamification aims to make it more fun.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am working on a web-based guitar RPG
You can fight monsters, craft, and conjure magic by playing real notes on your actual guitar. Web Browser Audio API handles pitch detection.
